# Kaleidoscope (kaleidoscope.dmh.dev)

> Real-time WebGL shader kaleidoscope continuously blending psychedelic fractal symmetry, sakura cherry blossoms, lotus mandalas, and crystal color palettes. Part of dmh.dev by Dennis Martin Herbers.

## Features
- Hands-free, continuously evolving WebGL fragment shader that smoothly crossfades across 6, 8, 10, and 12 mirror segments, floral sakura/lotus geometry, and harmonic color palettes without abrupt transitions.
- Unified glassmorphic top-left pill featuring the custom Kaleidoscope logo, optional inline performance HUD (FPS, frame time, and live SVG sparkline), and fullscreen mode.
